// Uno_Mas

//@version=6

// ============================================================================
// VWAP SESSION AND NY CASH
// ============================================================================
//
// OVERVIEW:
// This indicator displays two Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP) lines designed
// specifically for US equity markets:
//
//   1. NY VWAP (Cash Session VWAP) - Calculates VWAP for regular trading hours
//      only (9:30 AM - 4:00 PM ET). Resets daily at market open.
//
//   2. Session VWAP - Calculates VWAP for the full trading session including
//      pre-market and after-hours (6:00 PM - 4:00 PM ET next day). Only displays
//      when extended hours data is available on the chart.
//
// The Session VWAP also supports standard deviation bands for identifying
// potential support/resistance levels.
//
// ============================================================================

indicator("NYVWAP IB", overlay = true)

// ============================================================================
// CONSTANTS
// ============================================================================
// Time session definitions (America/New_York timezone)
const string TIMEZONE           = "America/New_York"
const string EXTENDED_SESSION   = "1800-0929"  // Extended hours: 6:00 PM to 9:29 AM
const string MARKET_SESSION     = "0930-1600"  // Regular market: 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM
const string IB_SESSION         = "0930-1030"  // Initial Balance: first hour

// Fully transparent color for label backgrounds
transparent = color.rgb(0, 0, 0, 100)

// ============================================================================
// USER INPUTS
// ============================================================================

// Calculation Settings
CALC_GROUP = "Calculation"
i_enableHD = input.bool(true, title = "Use 5-min data for precision", group = CALC_GROUP, tooltip = "On chart timeframes above 5 minutes, calculate VWAP using 5-minute bars for more accurate values. Prevents VWAP drift on higher timeframe charts.")
i_debugLog = input.bool(false, title = "Debug Logging", group = CALC_GROUP, tooltip = "Enable logging to Pine Logs for debugging. Logs every 30 minutes.")

// NY Cash VWAP Settings
NY_GROUP = "NY VWAP"
i_NY_color          = input.color(color.new(#4caf50, 0), title = "Color", group = NY_GROUP, inline = "line")
i_NY_width          = input.int(1, title = "Width", group = NY_GROUP, inline = "line")
i_NY_style          = input.string("Solid", title = "Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = NY_GROUP, inline = "line")
i_NY_showlabel      = input.bool(true, title = "Show Label", group = NY_GROUP, inline = "label")
i_NY_label          = input.string("NYVWAP", title = "", group = NY_GROUP, inline = "label")
i_NY_labelOffset    = input.int(0, title = "Offset", group = NY_GROUP, inline = "label")
i_NY_txtSize        = str.lower(input.string("Normal", title = "Label Size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large", "Huge"], group = NY_GROUP))
i_NY_showPriceScale = input.bool(true, title = "Show in Price Scale", group = NY_GROUP)

// NY Open & IB Settings
NY_OPEN_GROUP = "NY Open & Initial Balance"
i_showNYOpen      = input.bool(true, "Show NY Open", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP)
i_nyOpenColor     = input.color(color.gray, "Open Color", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "open")
i_nyOpenStyle     = input.string("Dashed", "Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "open")
i_showNYOpenLabel = input.bool(true, "Show Label", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "open_lab")
i_nyOpenLabelText = input.string("NY Open", "", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "open_lab")

i_showIB          = input.bool(true, "Show Initial Balance (IB)", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP)
i_ibColor         = input.color(color.new(#5b9cf6, 0), "IB Color", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "ib")
i_ibStyle         = input.string("Solid", "Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "ib")
i_ibWidth         = input.int(1, "Width", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "ib")
i_showIBLabel     = input.bool(true, "Show Labels", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "ib_lab")
i_ibHighLabelText = input.string("IB High", "", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "ib_lab")
i_ibLowLabelText  = input.string("IB Low", "", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP, inline = "ib_lab")
i_openIBLabOffset = input.int(0, "Label Offset", group = NY_OPEN_GROUP)

// IB Fibonacci Levels Settings
IB_FIB_GROUP = "IB Fibonacci Levels"
i_fibStyle    = input.string("Dotted", "Fib Line Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = IB_FIB_GROUP)
i_showFibLabs = input.bool(true, "Show Fib Labels", group = IB_FIB_GROUP)
i_fibLabType  = input.string("Level", "Label Content", options = ["Level", "Price"], group = IB_FIB_GROUP)

// Fib Slots 1-5
i_f1_on = input.bool(false, "Slot 1", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f1"), i_f1_val = input.float(0.236, "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f1"), i_f1_col = input.color(color.new(#787b86, 50), "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f1")
i_f2_on = input.bool(false, "Slot 2", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f2"), i_f2_val = input.float(0.382, "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f2"), i_f2_col = input.color(color.new(#f23645, 50), "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f2")
i_f3_on = input.bool(false, "Slot 3", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f3"), i_f3_val = input.float(0.500, "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f3"), i_f3_col = input.color(color.new(#4caf50, 50), "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f3")
i_f4_on = input.bool(false, "Slot 4", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f4"), i_f4_val = input.float(0.618, "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f4"), i_f4_col = input.color(color.new(#2962ff, 50), "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f4")
i_f5_on = input.bool(false, "Slot 5", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f5"), i_f5_val = input.float(0.786, "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f5"), i_f5_col = input.color(color.new(#9c27b0, 50), "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f5")
// Fib Slots 6-10
i_f6_on = input.bool(false, "Slot 6", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f6"), i_f6_val = input.float(1.000, "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f6"), i_f6_col = input.color(color.new(#787b86, 50), "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f6")
i_f7_on = input.bool(false, "Slot 7", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f7"), i_f7_val = input.float(1.272, "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f7"), i_f7_col = input.color(color.new(#787b86, 50), "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f7")
i_f8_on = input.bool(false, "Slot 8", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f8"), i_f8_val = input.float(1.618, "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f8"), i_f8_col = input.color(color.new(#787b86, 50), "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f8")
i_f9_on = input.bool(false, "Slot 9", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f9"), i_f9_val = input.float(2.000, "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f9"), i_f9_col = input.color(color.new(#787b86, 50), "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f9")
i_f10_on = input.bool(false, "Slot 10", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f10"), i_f10_val = input.float(2.618, "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f10"), i_f10_col = input.color(color.new(#787b86, 50), "", group = IB_FIB_GROUP, inline = "f10")

// Session VWAP Settings
SESSION_GROUP = "Session VWAP"
i_Session_enabled        = input.bool(true, title = "Enabled", group = SESSION_GROUP, tooltip = "Disable to skip Session VWAP calculation and rendering. Useful when using the built-in VWAP indicator separately.")
i_Session_color          = input.color(color.new(#04eb85, 0), title = "Color", group = SESSION_GROUP, inline = "line")
i_Session_width          = input.int(2, title = "Width", group = SESSION_GROUP, inline = "line")
i_Session_style          = input.string("Dashed", title = "Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = SESSION_GROUP, inline = "line")
i_Session_showlabel      = input.bool(true, title = "Show Label", group = SESSION_GROUP, inline = "label")
i_Session_label          = input.string("VWAP", title = "", group = SESSION_GROUP, inline = "label")
i_Session_labelOffset    = input.int(0, title = "Offset", group = SESSION_GROUP, inline = "label")
i_Session_txtSize        = str.lower(input.string("Normal", title = "Label Size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large", "Huge"], group = SESSION_GROUP))
i_Session_showPriceScale = input.bool(true, title = "Show in Price Scale", group = SESSION_GROUP)

// Session VWAP Bands Settings
BANDS_GROUP = "Session VWAP Bands"
i_showBand1       = input.bool(false, title = "Band Std Dev #1", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band1a")
i_bandMult1       = input.float(1.0, title = "", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band1a", step = 0.5, minval = 0)
i_bandStyle1      = input.string("Solid", title = "", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band1a")
i_bandColor1      = input.color(color.new(color.green, 0), title = "Line", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band1b")
i_bandFill1       = input.color(color.new(color.green, 90), title = "Fill", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band1b")
i_bandPriceScale1 = input.bool(false, title = "Price Scale", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band1b")

i_showBand2       = input.bool(false, title = "Band Std Dev #2", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band2a")
i_bandMult2       = input.float(2.0, title = "", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band2a", step = 0.5, minval = 0)
i_bandStyle2      = input.string("Solid", title = "", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band2a")
i_bandColor2      = input.color(color.new(color.olive, 0), title = "Line", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band2b")
i_bandFill2       = input.color(color.new(color.olive, 90), title = "Fill", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band2b")
i_bandPriceScale2 = input.bool(false, title = "Price Scale", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band2b")

i_showBand3       = input.bool(false, title = "Band Std Dev #3", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band3a")
i_bandMult3       = input.float(3.0, title = "", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band3a", step = 0.5, minval = 0)
i_bandStyle3      = input.string("Solid", title = "", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band3a")
i_bandColor3      = input.color(color.new(color.teal, 0), title = "Line", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band3b")
i_bandFill3       = input.color(color.new(color.teal, 90), title = "Fill", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band3b")
i_bandPriceScale3 = input.bool(false, title = "Price Scale", group = BANDS_GROUP, inline = "band3b")

// ============================================================================
// USER DEFINED TYPE
// ============================================================================
type myVWAP
    label lab
    int lab_offset
    bool isActive = true
    float cumPV = 0.0
    float cumVol = 0.0
    float vwap = na

// ============================================================================
// STATE VARIABLES
// ============================================================================

// Session VWAP - tracks full trading day (including extended hours)
var myVWAP sessionVWAP = myVWAP.new(
     label.new(bar_index, 0.0, text = "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = color.new(i_Session_color, 0), size = i_Session_txtSize),
     i_Session_labelOffset
 )

// Cash VWAP uses two alternating instances to handle the market open transition smoothly.
// When market opens, we swap which VWAP is "active" - the inactive one continues displaying
// the previous day's VWAP while the active one calculates the new day's VWAP.
var myVWAP cashVWAP1 = myVWAP.new(
     label.new(bar_index, 0.0, text = "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = color.new(i_NY_color, 0), size = i_NY_txtSize),
     i_NY_labelOffset
 )

var myVWAP cashVWAP2 = myVWAP.new(
     label.new(bar_index, 0.0, text = "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = color.new(i_NY_color, 0), size = i_NY_txtSize),
     i_NY_labelOffset,
     isActive = false
 )

// NY Open and IB Variables
var float nyOpenPrice = na
var float ibHigh = na
var float ibLow = na

// Fib Level State
var float[] fibLevels = array.new_float(10, na)
var label[] fibLabels = array.new_label(10, na)

// NY Open and IB Labels
var label nyOpenLab = label.new(bar_index, 0.0, text = "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = i_nyOpenColor, size = size.normal)
var label ibHighLab = label.new(bar_index, 0.0, text = "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = i_ibColor, size = size.normal)
var label ibLowLab  = label.new(bar_index, 0.0, text = "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = i_ibColor, size = size.normal)

// Initialize Fib Labels
if barstate.isfirst
    for i = 0 to 9
        array.set(fibLabels, i, label.new(bar_index, 0.0, "", style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, size = size.small))

// Display configurations
var sessionVWAPdisplay = i_Session_showPriceScale ? display.pane + display.data_window + display.status_line + display.price_scale : display.pane + display.data_window + display.status_line
var cashVWAPdisplay = i_NY_showPriceScale ? display.data_window + display.status_line + display.price_scale : display.data_window + display.status_line

var int activeCashVWAP = 1
var bool showSessionVWAP = false
var bool firstRun = true
var bool hasExtendedHoursData = false

// Session VWAP Band values
var float upperBand1 = na
var float lowerBand1 = na
var float upperBand2 = na
var float lowerBand2 = na
var float upperBand3 = na
var float lowerBand3 = na

// ============================================================================
// FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

resetVWAP(myVWAP vwap) =>
    vwap.cumPV := 0.0
    vwap.cumVol := 0.0
    vwap.vwap := 0.0

updateVWAP(myVWAP vwap, bool showLabel, string labelText) =>
    if vwap.isActive
        vwap.cumPV += hlc3 * volume
        vwap.cumVol += volume
        vwap.vwap := vwap.cumVol > 0 ? vwap.cumPV / vwap.cumVol : na

        vwap.lab.set_x(bar_index + vwap.lab_offset)
        vwap.lab.set_y(vwap.vwap)
        vwap.lab.set_text(showLabel ? labelText : "")
        vwap.lab.set_tooltip(showLabel ? str.tostring(vwap.vwap, format.mintick) : "")

calcHigherTimeframeVWAP(myVWAP vwap, simple string vwapPeriod, bool showLabel, string labelText) =>
    vwap.vwap := ta.vwap(hlc3, timeframe.change(vwapPeriod))
    vwap.lab.set_x(bar_index + vwap.lab_offset)
    vwap.lab.set_y(vwap.vwap)
    vwap.lab.set_text(showLabel ? labelText : "")
    vwap.lab.set_tooltip(showLabel ? str.tostring(vwap.vwap, format.mintick) : "")

// ============================================================================
// VOLUME VALIDATION
// ============================================================================
cumVolume = ta.cum(volume)
if barstate.islast and cumVolume == 0
    runtime.error("No volume is provided by the data vendor.")

// ============================================================================
// SESSION DETECTION
// ============================================================================
bool isExtendedSession = not na(time(timeframe.period, EXTENDED_SESSION, TIMEZONE))
bool isMarketSession = not na(time(timeframe.period, MARKET_SESSION, TIMEZONE))
bool isMarketOpen = isMarketSession and (isMarketSession != isMarketSession[1])
bool isIBPeriod = not na(time(timeframe.period, IB_SESSION, TIMEZONE))

// ============================================================================
// MAIN LOGIC
// ============================================================================

if firstRun
    firstRun := false
    if timeframe.isdaily or timeframe.isweekly
        label.delete(cashVWAP1.lab)
        label.delete(cashVWAP2.lab)
        label.delete(nyOpenLab)
        label.delete(ibHighLab)
        label.delete(ibLowLab)
        for lab in fibLabels
            label.delete(lab)
    if not i_Session_enabled
        label.delete(sessionVWAP.lab)

if timeframe.isdaily
    if i_Session_enabled
        calcHigherTimeframeVWAP(sessionVWAP, "1W", i_Session_showlabel, i_Session_label)
else if timeframe.isweekly
    if i_Session_enabled
        calcHigherTimeframeVWAP(sessionVWAP, "1M", i_Session_showlabel, i_Session_label)
else if timeframe.isintraday
    if session.islastbar_regular
        isMarketSession := false

    chartMinutes = timeframe.in_seconds() / 60
    useHD = i_enableHD and chartMinutes > 5 and chartMinutes < 1440

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // NY Open & IB Logic
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if isMarketOpen
        nyOpenPrice := open
        ibHigh := high
        ibLow := low
        for i = 0 to 9
            array.set(fibLevels, i, na)
    else if isIBPeriod
        ibHigh := math.max(nz(ibHigh, -1e10), high)
        ibLow := math.min(nz(ibLow, 1e10), low)
    
    // Calculate Fib Levels during and after IB
    if not na(ibHigh) and not na(ibLow)
        ibRange = ibHigh - ibLow
        
        // Update Levels using slots
        array.set(fibLevels, 0, i_f1_on ? ibLow + ibRange * i_f1_val : na)
        array.set(fibLevels, 1, i_f2_on ? ibLow + ibRange * i_f2_val : na)
        array.set(fibLevels, 2, i_f3_on ? ibLow + ibRange * i_f3_val : na)
        array.set(fibLevels, 3, i_f4_on ? ibLow + ibRange * i_f4_val : na)
        array.set(fibLevels, 4, i_f5_on ? ibLow + ibRange * i_f5_val : na)
        array.set(fibLevels, 5, i_f6_on ? ibLow + ibRange * i_f6_val : na)
        array.set(fibLevels, 6, i_f7_on ? ibLow + ibRange * i_f7_val : na)
        array.set(fibLevels, 7, i_f8_on ? ibLow + ibRange * i_f8_val : na)
        array.set(fibLevels, 8, i_f9_on ? ibLow + ibRange * i_f9_val : na)
        array.set(fibLevels, 9, i_f10_on ? ibLow + ibRange * i_f10_val : na)

    // Update NY Open and IB Labels
    if not na(nyOpenPrice) and i_showNYOpen and i_showNYOpenLabel
        nyOpenLab.set_xy(bar_index + i_openIBLabOffset, nyOpenPrice)
        nyOpenLab.set_text(i_nyOpenLabelText)
        nyOpenLab.set_textcolor(i_nyOpenColor)
    else
        nyOpenLab.set_text("")

    if not na(ibHigh) and i_showIB and i_showIBLabel
        ibHighLab.set_xy(bar_index + i_openIBLabOffset, ibHigh)
        ibHighLab.set_text(i_ibHighLabelText)
        ibHighLab.set_textcolor(i_ibColor)
    else
        ibHighLab.set_text("")

    if not na(ibLow) and i_showIB and i_showIBLabel
        ibLowLab.set_xy(bar_index + i_openIBLabOffset, ibLow)
        ibLowLab.set_text(i_ibLowLabelText)
        ibLowLab.set_textcolor(i_ibColor)
    else
        ibLowLab.set_text("")

    // Update Fib Labels
    color[] fibColors = array.from(i_f1_col, i_f2_col, i_f3_col, i_f4_col, i_f5_col, i_f6_col, i_f7_col, i_f8_col, i_f9_col, i_f10_col)
    float[] fibVals   = array.from(i_f1_val, i_f2_val, i_f3_val, i_f4_val, i_f5_val, i_f6_val, i_f7_val, i_f8_val, i_f9_val, i_f10_val)
    
    for i = 0 to 9
        lab = array.get(fibLabels, i)
        lev = array.get(fibLevels, i)
        if not na(lev) and i_showFibLabs and isMarketSession
            lab.set_xy(bar_index + i_openIBLabOffset, lev)
            lab.set_textcolor(array.get(fibColors, i))
            txt = i_fibLabType == "Level" ? str.tostring(array.get(fibVals, i), "#.###") : str.tostring(lev, format.mintick)
            lab.set_text(txt)
        else
            lab.set_text("")

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Cash VWAP Logic
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    var float[] pvArray_hd = array.new_float(0)
    var float[] volArray_hd = array.new_float(0)
    var int lastResetDay_hd = -1
    float nyVwapHD = na
    
    if useHD
        [hlc3Array, volArray, timeArray] = request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, "5", [hlc3, volume, time])
        if array.size(hlc3Array) > 0
            for i = 0 to array.size(hlc3Array) - 1
                barTime = array.get(timeArray, i)
                barHlc3 = array.get(hlc3Array, i)
                barVol = array.get(volArray, i)
                d = dayofmonth(barTime, TIMEZONE)
                is930 = (hour(barTime, TIMEZONE) == 9 and minute(barTime, TIMEZONE) == 30)
                if is930 and d != lastResetDay_hd
                    array.clear(pvArray_hd)
                    array.clear(volArray_hd)
                    lastResetDay_hd := d
                if barVol > 0
                    array.push(pvArray_hd, barHlc3 * barVol)
                    array.push(volArray_hd, barVol)
            if array.size(pvArray_hd) > 0
                nyVwapHD := array.sum(volArray_hd) > 0 ? array.sum(pvArray_hd) / array.sum(volArray_hd) : na

    if isMarketOpen
        if activeCashVWAP == 1
            activeCashVWAP := 2
            cashVWAP1.isActive := false, cashVWAP2.isActive := true
            cashVWAP1.lab.set_text(""), cashVWAP1.lab.set_tooltip("")
            resetVWAP(cashVWAP2)
            if useHD and not na(nyVwapHD)
                cashVWAP2.vwap := nyVwapHD
                cashVWAP2.lab.set_xy(bar_index + cashVWAP2.lab_offset, cashVWAP2.vwap)
                cashVWAP2.lab.set_text(i_NY_showlabel ? i_NY_label : "")
            else
                updateVWAP(cashVWAP2, i_NY_showlabel, i_NY_label)
        else
            activeCashVWAP := 1
            cashVWAP1.isActive := true, cashVWAP2.isActive := false
            cashVWAP2.lab.set_text(""), cashVWAP2.lab.set_tooltip("")
            resetVWAP(cashVWAP1)
            if useHD and not na(nyVwapHD)
                cashVWAP1.vwap := nyVwapHD
                cashVWAP1.lab.set_xy(bar_index + cashVWAP1.lab_offset, cashVWAP1.vwap)
                cashVWAP1.lab.set_text(i_NY_showlabel ? i_NY_label : "")
            else
                updateVWAP(cashVWAP1, i_NY_showlabel, i_NY_label)
    else
        if useHD and not na(nyVwapHD)
            cur = cashVWAP1.isActive ? cashVWAP1 : cashVWAP2
            cur.vwap := nyVwapHD
            cur.lab.set_xy(bar_index + cur.lab_offset, cur.vwap)
            cur.lab.set_text(i_NY_showlabel ? i_NY_label : "")
        else
            updateVWAP(cashVWAP1, i_NY_showlabel, i_NY_label)
            updateVWAP(cashVWAP2, i_NY_showlabel, i_NY_label)

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Session VWAP Logic
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if i_Session_enabled
        if isExtendedSession and not hasExtendedHoursData
            hasExtendedHoursData := true, showSessionVWAP := true

    isNewDay = timeframe.change("1D")
    [vwapStd, stdevUpperStd, _] = ta.vwap(hlc3, isNewDay, 1)
    stdevAbsStd = stdevUpperStd - vwapStd
    
    float vwapVal = vwapStd, float stdevAbs = stdevAbsStd
    if useHD
        vH = request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, "5", ta.vwap(hlc3, timeframe.change("1D")))
        vwapVal := array.size(vH) > 0 ? array.last(vH) : na
        [_, sUH, _] = ta.vwap(hlc3, timeframe.change("1D"), 1)
        sH = request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, "5", sUH)
        stdevAbs := array.size(sH) > 0 ? nz(array.last(sH)) - nz(vwapVal) : na
    
    if i_Session_enabled and showSessionVWAP
        sessionVWAP.vwap := vwapVal
        sessionVWAP.lab.set_xy(bar_index + sessionVWAP.lab_offset, sessionVWAP.vwap)
        sessionVWAP.lab.set_text(i_Session_showlabel ? i_Session_label : "")

    showBands = i_Session_enabled and showSessionVWAP and not session.islastbar
    upperBand1 := showBands ? vwapVal + stdevAbs * i_bandMult1 : na
    lowerBand1 := showBands ? vwapVal - stdevAbs * i_bandMult1 : na
    upperBand2 := showBands ? vwapVal + stdevAbs * i_bandMult2 : na
    lowerBand2 := showBands ? vwapVal - stdevAbs * i_bandMult2 : na
    upperBand3 := showBands ? vwapVal + stdevAbs * i_bandMult3 : na
    lowerBand3 := showBands ? vwapVal - stdevAbs * i_bandMult3 : na

// ============================================================================
// PLOTS
// ============================================================================

f_getStyle(s) => s == "Solid" ? plot.linestyle_solid : s == "Dashed" ? plot.linestyle_dashed : plot.linestyle_dotted

// Basic Plots
plot(i_showNYOpen and isMarketSession ? nyOpenPrice : na, "NY Open", i_nyOpenColor, 1, plot.style_linebr, linestyle = f_getStyle(i_nyOpenStyle))
plot(i_showIB and isMarketSession ? ibHigh : na, "IB High", i_ibColor, i_ibWidth, plot.style_linebr, linestyle = f_getStyle(i_ibStyle))
plot(i_showIB and isMarketSession ? ibLow : na, "IB Low", i_ibColor, i_ibWidth, plot.style_linebr, linestyle = f_getStyle(i_ibStyle))

// IB Fib Plots (Manual for Each Slot)
fibLinestyle = f_getStyle(i_fibStyle)
plot(isMarketSession ? array.get(fibLevels, 0) : na, "Fib 1", i_f1_col, 1, plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fibLinestyle)
plot(isMarketSession ? array.get(fibLevels, 1) : na, "Fib 2", i_f2_col, 1, plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fibLinestyle)
plot(isMarketSession ? array.get(fibLevels, 2) : na, "Fib 3", i_f3_col, 1, plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fibLinestyle)
plot(isMarketSession ? array.get(fibLevels, 3) : na, "Fib 4", i_f4_col, 1, plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fibLinestyle)
plot(isMarketSession ? array.get(fibLevels, 4) : na, "Fib 5", i_f5_col, 1, plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fibLinestyle)
plot(isMarketSession ? array.get(fibLevels, 5) : na, "Fib 6", i_f6_col, 1, plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fibLinestyle)
plot(isMarketSession ? array.get(fibLevels, 6) : na, "Fib 7", i_f7_col, 1, plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fibLinestyle)
plot(isMarketSession ? array.get(fibLevels, 7) : na, "Fib 8", i_f8_col, 1, plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fibLinestyle)
plot(isMarketSession ? array.get(fibLevels, 8) : na, "Fib 9", i_f9_col, 1, plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fibLinestyle)
plot(isMarketSession ? array.get(fibLevels, 9) : na, "Fib 10", i_f10_col, 1, plot.style_linebr, linestyle = fibLinestyle)

// VWAPs
plot(i_Session_enabled ? sessionVWAP.vwap : na, "Session VWAP", i_Session_color, i_Session_width, plot.style_linebr, display = sessionVWAPdisplay, linestyle = f_getStyle(i_Session_style))

// Bands
u1 = plot(upperBand1, "U1", i_bandColor1, style = plot.style_linebr, display = i_showBand1 and i_Session_enabled ? (i_bandPriceScale1 ? display.pane + display.price_scale : display.pane) : display.none, linestyle = f_getStyle(i_bandStyle1))
l1 = plot(lowerBand1, "L1", i_bandColor1, style = plot.style_linebr, display = i_showBand1 and i_Session_enabled ? (i_bandPriceScale1 ? display.pane + display.price_scale : display.pane) : display.none, linestyle = f_getStyle(i_bandStyle1))
fill(u1, l1, color = i_bandFill1, display = i_showBand1 and i_Session_enabled ? display.all : display.none)

u2 = plot(upperBand2, "U2", i_bandColor2, style = plot.style_linebr, display = i_showBand2 and i_Session_enabled ? (i_bandPriceScale2 ? display.pane + display.price_scale : display.pane) : display.none, linestyle = f_getStyle(i_bandStyle2))
l2 = plot(lowerBand2, "L2", i_bandColor2, style = plot.style_linebr, display = i_showBand2 and i_Session_enabled ? (i_bandPriceScale2 ? display.pane + display.price_scale : display.pane) : display.none, linestyle = f_getStyle(i_bandStyle2))
fill(u2, l2, color = i_bandFill2, display = i_showBand2 and i_Session_enabled ? display.all : display.none)

u3 = plot(upperBand3, "U3", i_bandColor3, style = plot.style_linebr, display = i_showBand3 and i_Session_enabled ? (i_bandPriceScale3 ? display.pane + display.price_scale : display.pane) : display.none, linestyle = f_getStyle(i_bandStyle3))
l3 = plot(lowerBand3, "L3", i_bandColor3, style = plot.style_linebr, display = i_showBand3 and i_Session_enabled ? (i_bandPriceScale3 ? display.pane + display.price_scale : display.pane) : display.none, linestyle = f_getStyle(i_bandStyle3))
fill(u3, l3, color = i_bandFill3, display = i_showBand3 and i_Session_enabled ? display.all : display.none)

// Cash VWAP
cv = cashVWAP1.isActive ? cashVWAP1.vwap : cashVWAP2.vwap
plot(cv, "Cash VWAP", i_NY_color, i_NY_width, plot.style_linebr, display = cashVWAPdisplay, linestyle = f_getStyle(i_NY_style))
plot(cashVWAP1.isActive ? cashVWAP1.vwap : na, "C1", i_NY_color, i_NY_width, plot.style_linebr, display = display.pane, linestyle = f_getStyle(i_NY_style))
plot(cashVWAP2.isActive ? cashVWAP2.vwap : na, "C2", i_NY_color, i_NY_width, plot.style_linebr, display = display.pane, linestyle = f_getStyle(i_NY_style))
